'''Kharedst's memoirs''' is a [[quest items|quest item]] reward in [[Client of Kourend]]. The book is obtained from [[Veos]], who bought it at an auction, and can be reclaimed by speaking to him (or [[Cabin Boy Herbert]] after partial completion of [[A Kingdom Divided]]) on the [[Port Piscarilius]] docks should players lose it.

It is an equipable book that was a gift from [[King Kharedst IV]], the last king of Great Kourend, to his only daughter [[Rose]]. If players have lost the [[Page (Kharedst's memoirs)|pages]] before putting them in the book, they can be reclaimed from the respective lords of each Kourend house; see the table below for the relevant quests. If the book is charged when destroyed, all charges are retained. After completion of [[A Kingdom Divided]], the book gets upgraded to the [[book of the dead]], which is reclaimed from [[Commander Fullore]] instead. 

The memoirs inside can be read, containing various outings Rose experienced with her father.
